settings.description: Make this workspace feel right for you.

dataManagement.title: Data management
dataManagement.description: Keep a backup of your local workspace or export tasks for analysis.
dataManagement.loadFailed: Could not read your local workspace. Try again.
dataManagement.notes: JSON backups up to 20 MiB are processed on this device. Backups include projects and tasks, not interface preferences. CSV is for export and analysis; use JSON to restore.
dataManagement.exportedJson: Backup ready. Check your browser downloads.
dataManagement.exportedCsv: CSV ready. Check your browser downloads.
dataManagement.restoreDescription: This replaces all local projects and tasks with the selected backup. Existing records not in the backup will be removed. Interface preferences stay unchanged. Download a backup first if you need to keep the current data.

errors.BACKUP_INVALID: This file is not a valid Saturnino backup. Select a valid backup file.
errors.BACKUP_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED: This backup version is not supported by this application.
errors.BACKUP_TOO_LARGE: The JSON backup exceeds the 20 MiB limit.
errors.WORKSPACE_CHANGED: Your workspace changed after this preview. Cancel and select the backup again to review the current data.
errors.BACKUP_READ_FAILED: Could not read the file. Select it again.
errors.ACTION_FAILED: Could not complete this action. Try again.

pwa.title: App and offline use
pwa.installDescription: Install Saturnino from your browser menu when available. Complete an online visit before relying on offline use.

pwa.checkFailed: Could not check for updates. Check your connection and try again.
pwa.updateFailed: Could not apply the update. Save your work and try again.
pwa.updateDescription: Save your changes before reloading. Your saved projects and tasks will stay on this device.
pwa.storageNote: Offline caching stores application files. Projects and tasks stay in this browser. Keep JSON backups before clearing browser data.
